jobs.title: Maven Clinic: Manager, Payments & Reconciliation
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  Remote
 

  Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com 
  An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:   
 
 TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) 
 Fortune Change the World (2024) 
 CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) 
 Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) 
 Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) 
 Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) 
 Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

 Maven is seeking a Manager, Payments & Reconciliation to lead the end-to-end financial operations and reconciliation framework across our enterprise and consumer programs. Reporting into the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team, you will architect a robust, scalable payment integrity program. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of payment funding, from accurate invoicing and money movement oversight to complex account reconciliation, while partnering with Product/Engineering to build automated financial controls that ensure operational excellence at scale. 
  As a   Manager, Payments & Reconciliation   at Maven, you will:  
 
 Oversee the end-to-end movement of payment funds across Maven’s Enterprise and Consumer programs, ensuring transaction accuracy, timely disbursement, and integrity across the full funding pipeline, including fee-for-service claims payments. 
 Own client and payer invoicing for payment funding programs and the timely reconciliation of complex claims funding account transactions and balances, ensuring paid claims tie back to funding. 
 Monitor clinic, provider, and fee-for-service claims payments against contracted rates and timeliness standards, identifying overpayments, underpayments, and SLA gaps, and partnering with operations to resolve root causes and recover funds. 
 Manage Maven's floated benefit funding program, including tracking outstanding float balances, driving timely recoupment from clients and payers, and escalating aging exposure to Finance. 
 Lead cross-functional root cause analyses on financial discrepancies and drive continuous process improvements that prevent billing errors, optimize cash flow, and increase the accuracy and scalability of the payments and invoicing function. 
 Partner with Finance during the month-end close process, including supporting the preparation of detailed bank reconciliations, owning reporting deliverables and assisting with analyses around collections risk. 
 Act as the financial subject matter expert for Client Success, equipping CSMs with detailed reconciliation insights and structural solutions to resolve billing disputes and optimize the client funding experience. 
 Act as the business owner for funding tools, collaborating with Product and Engineering to design application enhancements, resolve bugs, and automate financial workflows. 
 Establish and uphold strong internal controls and accountability standards to support audit readiness and financial compliance. 
 
  We’re looking for you to bring:  
 
 6+ years in revenue cycle management, financial analysis, or payment operations, with direct experience in payment funding, fee for service, settlements, reconciliation, claims funding accounts or healthcare payment operations strongly preferred. 
 Demonstrated readiness to lead a team, with experience mentoring junior staff, managing cross-functional workstreams, or standing in for a manager.

jobs.title: Coinbase: Corporate Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  Remote - USA
 

  Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  Learn more about working at Coinbase . 
    The Controllership team is seeking a Corporate Accounting Manager to lead core accounting operations across global month-end close, operating expenses, operating cash, and capitalized software. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, you will own end-to-end close activities across global entities, strengthen internal controls, and partner with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Product, and Engineering to turn complex product launches into close-ready operational processes. 
 What you’ll do: 
 
 Lead month-end and quarter-end close activities across global entities, including journal entries, reconciliations, account analysis, foreign-currency revaluation and remeasurement, and consolidated reporting. 
 Own accounting operations for key operating expense categories, including G&A, accruals, prepayments, amortization, vendor spend, and capitalized software in partnership with FP&A; deliver clear balance-sheet reconciliations and P&L fluctuation analysis. 
 Oversee operating cash reconciliations, aging of reconciling items, and close-related partnership with Treasury. 
 Design, implement, and document SOX-compliant controls across corporate accounting and close workflows, and support internal and external audits with schedules and account substantiation. 
 Drive automation across the close, partnering with Finance Systems and Engineering to streamline reconciliations, invoice-to-pay, and reporting workflows, and to deliver NetSuite enhancements that support them. 
 Lead the automation of the accruals process, increasing automated accrual coverage and reducing manual journal entries in partnership with FP&A and Engineering. 
 Coach and develop staff, fostering accountability, sound judgment, and continuous improvement. 
 
 Required Skills and Experience: 
 
 CPA and a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 
 9+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2+ years leading or managing people or accounting work. 
 Experience in corporate accounting, including leading multi-entity month-end close, operating expenses, variance analysis, cash reconciliation, FX, and consolidated reporting, at a publicly traded or high-growth technology company. 
 Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and internal controls, with direct experience implementing and maintaining SOX 404 documentation and compliance. 
 Demonstrated ability to resolve complex accounting and operational issues and improve close processes. 
 Experience implementing or optimizing an enterprise ERP; NetSuite or a comparable system preferred, with strong spreadsheet skills; SQL or analytics-tool experience (Snowflake, Looker, or similar) a plus.  
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to adapt in a changing environment. 
 Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. jobs.title: Talkspace: Health Educator (Contract)
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  New York, NY (Remote)
 

  At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!   
  Our team at Wisdo Health is seeking a Certified Health Education Specialist (CHES) to lead webinar-style orientation sessions for members beginning a GLP-1 coaching program. These live virtual sessions provide general education about GLP-1 medications and introduce members to the health coaching program, helping them understand what to expect throughout their journey. This is an education and orientation role. Health Educators provide general health education but do not provide medical advice, medication recommendations, or individualized clinical guidance.  
    This is a remote position based in the United States. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.    
   What You’ll Do   
 
 Provide general health education to members in a live, webinar-style setting to introduce GLP-1 medications and the health coaching program. 
 Support members in understanding foundational, general information about their medication and how health coaching complements their broader health journey. 
 Collaborate with program staff and coaching leadership to prepare members for coaching and set clear expectations. 
 Utilize presentation and facilitation techniques to deliver clear, engaging, and accessible educational content. 
 Follow approved educational content, program guidance, and organizational policies.

 The Opportunity 
 About our platform 
 Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. 
 The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. 
 About the Infrastructure group 
 We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

 Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

 Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response. 
 Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

     Foreign Policy   (FP) is seeking two part-time interns to join our Strategic Development Team in Washington, D.C., during Spring 2027, ideally beginning in January and ending in May. This position is expected to start in January of 2027 with a preferred availability of 15-20 hours per week.   Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. jobs.description:
At  Qualtrics , we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.  Solutions Consultant - Senior Principal, NA ENT   Why We Have This Role   Our pre-sales team helps some of the largest organizations in the world find and close experience gaps with the  Qualtrics  XM Data & AI Platform, which combines experience management (XM) data with artificial intelligence (AI) to predict what comes next and act on it.  As a Solutions Consultant in our Financial Services and Insurance (FSI) business, you will partner with Sales Teams on opportunities across banking, insurance, wealth and asset management, and payments. You bring the product skills to show what the platform can do and the strategic perspective to help business leaders decide what to do with it. In an industry shaped by regulation, rising customer expectations, digital disruption and retention pressure, you will connect XM and AI to outcomes FSI leaders care about, such as customer loyalty, advisor and agent effectiveness, claims and servicing quality, and operational risk.  While most of your efforts will be focused in the pre-sales environment, some additional cross-functional initiatives may include input in product direction, content generation, contributing to analyst reports/relationships and attending marketing events.  You will report to a Solution Consulting Manager.   How You’ll Find Success   
 Earning trust with Account Executives as their go-to partner on deal strategy and execution in FSI accounts. 
 Becoming a trusted advisor to customer business and technology leaders, helping them build their XM vision and a roadmap toward the art of the possible. 
 Building and delivering compelling product demonstrations that show the value of  Qualtrics  in the context of FSI use cases and workflows. 
 Winning the technical decision and the business case on enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders. 
 Contributing to team outcomes, including win rate, pipeline, net new annual recurring revenue (ARR) and customer satisfaction. 
 Sharing what works and helping your peers grow. 
   How You’ll Grow   
 Learn the full XM platform, including customer experience, employee experience and market research, and the AI capabilities that connect them. 
 Build deep FSI expertise across banking, insurance, wealth management and payments, including the regulatory, security and data considerations that shape buying decisions. 
 Deepen your expertise in AI and data and shape how FSI customers apply them to business outcomes. 
 Build influence with Product and Marketing by bringing field insight into product direction and go-to-market strategy. 
 Grow your career through a structured promotion process, career action planning with your manager, and internal mobility (Qmobility). 
 As we build an AI-first company and change the market for Experience Management, you will be at the cutting edge of this transformation in enterprise software. 
   Things You’ll Do

 Contribute to discovery by owning technical discovery, uncovering business challenges and tying them to measurable outcomes. 
 Design, build and deliver tailored use case solutions and demonstrations, including FSI scenarios such as digital banking journeys, contact center and voice of the customer programs, claims and policy experiences, advisor and agent feedback, and employee engagement. 
 Build business cases and value stories that translate product capabilities into value drivers for FSI buyers, connecting XM and AI to revenue, cost and risk.

 Advise customers on XM program design and governance, including use-case prioritization, data sources, closed-loop action, a phased maturity roadmap, program ownership, operating model and regulatory considerations specific to financial services.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, DeFi Liquidity
jobs.description:
Circle  (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.  Circle ’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC,  Circle  Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use  Circle  to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .  What you’ll be part of:   Circle  is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.   What you'll be responsible for:   As Business Development Manager, DeFi Liquidity, you will lead the design, execution, and optimization of liquidity programs supporting trading activity on Arc,  Circle 's blockchain network for institutional-grade on-chain financial activity. Working closely with colleagues responsible for external venue partnerships and internal trading products, you will ensure that both internal and external venues have the liquidity infrastructure and participation needed to support effective trading. You will leverage existing relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading firms while developing new partnerships, building data-driven liquidity strategies, and managing programs from initial structuring through deployment and ongoing performance optimization. Your work will help establish sustainable liquidity, improve trading execution, and support the growth of Arc's on-chain trading ecosystem.   What you'll work on:   
 Design and execute liquidity programs for internal and external Arc trading venues, aligning incentives with venue structure and trading requirements. 
 Develop and expand relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading firms to support liquidity deployment across Arc. 
 Build financial and liquidity models evaluating TVL requirements, fee structures, incentive economics, slippage, and expected trading activity. 
 Partner with Product and Venue GTM teams to inform trading venue design, liquidity architecture, fee tiers, and integration strategies. 
 Lead liquidity partnership negotiations, including program proposals, commercial terms, capital commitments, and deployment coordination. 
 Monitor liquidity performance, trading volume, capital efficiency, and incentive effectiveness to identify opportunities for optimization. 
 Translate DeFi market structure developments and liquidity provider feedback into actionable recommendations that strengthen Arc's trading ecosystem. 
  What you'll bring to  Circle :   Core Requirements  
 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial hands-on experience in crypto, DeFi trading, or liquidity provision. 
 Direct experience designing, executing, or managing on-chain liquidity programs within a DeFi protocol, market maker, or trading firm. 
 Strong knowledge of DeFi market structure, including AMMs, concentrated liquidity, proprietary AMMs, liquidity provisioning models, and aggregator routing. 
 Demonstrated ability to model liquidity requirements, incentive economics, fee optimization, and slippage to support data-driven commercial decisions. 
 Established relationships with DeFi liquidity providers, market makers, and trading desks, with experience developing and managing commercial partnerships. 
 Experience negotiating liquidity arrangements and managing the commercial lifecycle from initial engagement through deployment and ongoing optimization. 
 Ability to collaborate with Product and Engineering teams, evaluate technical specifications, and translate liquidity requirements into actionable product recommendations. 
   Preferred Requirements  
 Experience deploying liquidity across multiple decentralized trading venues or supporting new blockchain ecosystem launches. 
 Knowledge of emerging DeFi liquidity provisioning techniques, market structure innovations, and evolving liquidity incentive models. 
    Circle  is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. jobs.title: Project Manager (ERP Automation)
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!    Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.   Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.   To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.   BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.    Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.     Location   This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne, where we have recently established new BLP hubs. Regardless of your location, you will start with a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month). Afterwards, you can work from home or from one of our hubs, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP.  Your Mission  You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.   As a Project Manager , most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.  You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:  
   Guided onboarding  for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.  
   Leading yourself  on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.  
   Alongside a Senior Project Manager  on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.  
  Your Career Path in Project Management  This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.  
   Project Manager:  You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs.  Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.   
   Senior Project Manager:  You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement.  Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.   
   Next steps:  Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.  
  Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.  Key Responsibilities  
  Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.  
  Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.  
  Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.  
  Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.  
  Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.  
  Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.  
  Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.  
  In addition, as a Senior Project Manager  
  Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.  
  Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.  
  Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.  
  Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.  
  Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

The team combines deep domain expertise across global trade, maritime activity, commodities and risk analytics with a mandate to deliver sustained commercial growth and meaningful client outcomes. Colleagues operate across a global, matrixed environment, partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Technology and Client Success to advance both the near-term commercial agenda and a longer-term innovation pipeline. Full-time | Remote, U.S. | 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central   Who We Are and What We Do  We believe the best marketing comes from what a business owner already knows.  Fluxe Digital Marketing  is a content marketing agency that interviews business owners about their expertise, then turns one hour of their time each month into a month of content in their own voice. Since 2009 we have worked with more than 150 clients across more than 30 industries, from concierge medical practices to ecommerce brands.  Please take some time to learn about our mission and values. They drive everything we do.  Why This Role Exists  Search is changing. AI answers now handle more questions before anyone visits a site, so showing up in search no longer guarantees the click. We are hiring a strategist who knows search deeply and can work out what each client should do about it, then own the plan from start to follow-through.  If this sounds like the work you want to do, we’d like to meet you.  What You’ll Do  Lead search and AI visibility  
 Track each client’s rankings and how often AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews mention and cite them. 
 Find out why traffic moved, and decide what to fix, refresh, write, or stop. 
 Turn that into a three-month plan our writers and web team can act on. 
 Write the copy that matters most for search: product, category, and landing page copy, content briefs, and titles and meta descriptions. 
 Write clear specs a developer can build from, such as page templates, redirects, and structured data. 
  Own each client’s plan  
 Write and update a three-month plan for each client you lead. 
 Turn every client call into clear next steps with an owner and a date, then follow up until each one is done. 
 Bring us ideas that grow each client’s results. 
  Run the monthly reports and call prep  
 Pull the numbers from GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and the ad platforms, and explain what changed and what we will do next. 
 Write the agenda for each client call so the team walks in ready. 
  You’ll start with about five clients and add more as you settle in, working with our head strategist, our editors, and our CRO and ads specialist. To see the kind of work our clients get, look at our case studies and how our process works.  How We’ll Measure Success  
 Every client you lead has tracking in place and a search plan built from the data. 
 Your clients’ rankings, AI visibility, organic clicks, and the inquiries search brings in move in the right direction against where they started. 
 Every client you lead has a current plan, every commitment from a client call is tracked and closed, and reports and call prep arrive on time. 
  Logistics  
 Full-time, 100 percent remote position. 
 Working hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central time. 
 We expect to close applications by December 31, 2026, and may extend. 
  How We Hire  We keep our process simple and we pay you for your time on the test.  
 Apply and answer the questions in the application. 
 A 30-minute video call with our team, including a short screen-share walkthrough of one piece of your work. 
 A short paid test project based on a real search situation. 
 Two interviews: one about your career so far, and one with our founder. 
   What to send:  your resume, your LinkedIn profile, a search audit, plan, or report you are proud of, and one page or landing page you wrote for search (anonymized is fine).   A note on AI:  we use AI every day and expect you to as well. In your answers, give us the specifics only you would know: the situation, the numbers, and what changed. Polished but general answers will not move forward.  Interested? We’d love to hear from you!   Fluxe Digital Marketing  is an equal opportunity employer.  Requirements  What We’re Looking For  Required  
 At least three years of hands-on SEO strategy, at an agency or in-house, where you owned the plan and the results for at least a few sites or clients. 
 Weekly use of Ahrefs or Semrush, plus GA4 and Google Search Console. 
 Experience diagnosing a traffic drop or a ranking problem, including technical causes. 
 A working understanding of how AI search tools choose what to cite, and experience tracking it. 
 Strong writing for search, including page copy, landing page drafts, content briefs, and titles and meta descriptions, with samples you can share. 
 Writing that a busy business owner can read once and act on. 
 Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, along with the judgment to know when the output is wrong.

  Jack Westin  is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials.    MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Designer   (Remote, Project-based) 
   Role Summary   
 The MCAT Psych/Soc Curriculum Developer is responsible for building lesson materials for  Jack Westin 's relaunched live MCAT courses, which launch in January 2027 with a new modular curriculum. This project-based role focuses on turning detailed lesson outlines into clear, engaging slide decks and student handouts for four Psych/Soc lessons across two topic blocks: Research Methods & Social Psychology and Neuroscience & Cognition. The Curriculum Developer works independently and collaboratively with our curriculum and instructor teams to deliver high-quality, teachable materials that follow  Jack Westin 's template and style standards. 
   Compensation Terms:   
 
 
  $300 per lesson  , or $1,200 for all four lessons 
 Pay includes one round of revisions after review 
 All lessons due by   January 1, 2027  
 
   Project-based contract   
 Work remotely with flexible scheduling 
 
 
   Primary     Responsibilities   We're looking for a contractor to build four Psych/Soc lessons across two blocks. 
   Research Methods & Social Psychology   
   
 
  RM.1 Research Design & Social Influence  : observational vs. experimental research, biases, statistical analysis, and related topics 
 
  RM.2 Stress, Identity & Society  : mixed P/S topics taught through famous research experiments, with a close look at how those studies were designed 
   
   Neuroscience & Cognition   
   
 
  NC.1 Brain, Senses & Learning  : a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections 
 
  NC.2 Memory, Perception & Cognition  : a science lesson focused on clinical applications and content connections 
   
 Each lesson is a 3-hour live class. It opens with a case study, builds on key concepts from the prep work, shows interdisciplinary connections that are often tested together on the MCAT, and then moves into strategy, practice questions, and an AAMC passage. You'll turn a detailed lesson outline from our Director of Curriculum Design (often 10 to 20 pages per lesson) into clear, teachable material. 
    Slide & Handout Creation    
 
 Create a "Prep in 15" slide deck for each lesson, giving an overview of foundational and high-yield topics 
 Create an in-class slide deck covering the content portion of each live class (about 1.5 hours) 
 Build fillable student note handouts for both the Prep in 15 and the in-class lecture once slides are final 
 Follow  Jack Westin 's slide template and style guide throughout 
 
    Quality Assurance    
 
 Ensure content is accurate, clear, and aligned with the learning objectives in each lesson outline 
 Self-review lessons against  Jack Westin 's template and style standards before submission 
 Complete one round of revisions based on lead instructor feedback before final approval 
 
    Collaboration & Communication    
 
 Track all lessons and communicate with the team in ClickUp 
 Respond to lead instructor reviews, which are given within 2 business days of submission 
 Focus on lesson content only (quiz questions, homework, and passage selection are handled by other teams) 
 
 
 Qualifications 
   Education & Credentials   
 
 Strong command of MCAT Psych/Soc content, including research methods and neuroscience 
 A strong MCAT score is a plus 
 
   Experience   
 
 Experience teaching or tutoring the MCAT 
 Experience turning detailed outlines into lesson materials or slide-based instruction

 Ability to build clean, clear slides that follow a template and style guide 
 Strong understanding of how students learn MCAT Psych/Soc content 
 Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines 
 Responsive to feedback and comfortable with revision cycles 
 Proficiency with slide tools and ClickUp or similar project management tools

 As the  Director, Workforce Management , you will connect workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, leadership capacity, and performance management into one operating system, giving the organization clear visibility into whether we are on pace and what needs to change when we are not. 
  As Director, Workforce Management, you will:  
 
  Own the CCV workforce plan end to end.  Build and run the staffing strategy required to scale the clinician organization, translating long-range growth targets into weekly and monthly hiring, onboarding, and readiness goals. 
  Create visibility from candidate pipeline to “ready to visit.”  Establish the operating metrics, forecasting, and reporting needed to understand recruiting conversion, onboarding lead times, attrition, training capacity, and clinician readiness—and surface risks early enough to act. 
  Build a scalable clinician onboarding model.  Partner across Clinical, Talent, IT, Operations, and other teams to evolve today’s high-touch onboarding journey into a structured model that can support significantly larger hiring cohorts without sacrificing clinical quality. 
  Build the leadership capacity required to scale.  Determine the right model for preceptors, clinical leads, onboarding cohorts, and frontline management so that rapid growth does not create an unsustainable burden on existing clinical leaders. 
  Own workforce performance management.  Establish clear, actionable standards and operating rhythms across areas such as attendance, cancellation rates, Clover Assistant Touch, productivity, and normalized performance measures. 
  Make quality and productivity work together.  Build performance expectations that reflect accurate, sustainable clinical performance—not simply higher activity—and partner with clinical leaders to ensure workforce decisions support both member experience and quality of care. 
  Turn workforce data into decisions.  Build the dashboards, forecasts, and management routines leaders need to understand capacity, identify constraints, allocate resources, and stay ahead of hiring or performance gaps. 
  Create repeatable workforce-management capabilities for CCS.  Use the CCV ramp as the first proving ground for processes, tools, and operating models that can later support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs. 
  Operate as a cross-functional leader.  Bring together Clinical Activation, clinical leadership, Talent, Operations, Finance, analytics, and other partners around one integrated workforce plan with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths. 
 
  Success in this role looks like:  
  In your first 90 days, you will:  
 
 Build a clear baseline of the CCV workforce funnel and translate the 2027 growth target into a measurable workforce plan spanning recruiting, onboarding, training capacity, clinician readiness, and attrition. 
 Identify the biggest risks and bottlenecks in the ramp and establish the metrics, operating cadence, and accountability needed to address them. 
 
  Within your first 6 months, you will:  
 
 Establish a predictable recruiting-to-readiness operating model, including scalable onboarding cohorts, preceptor capacity, and clinical leadership support. 
 Launch workforce dashboards and performance-management routines that enable leaders to anticipate capacity gaps, manage performance, and increase clinician onboarding volume without sacrificing quality. 
 
  Over time, you will:  
 
 Help CCV reach its clinician-capacity goals ahead of the 2027 AEP cycle through a sustainable, data-driven approach to hiring, onboarding, and performance. 
 Build repeatable workforce-management capabilities that can extend beyond CCV to support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs.

   About Carrot:   
  Carrot  is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. jobs.title: ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters:  Remote-US-CA
 

  ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.    We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical force multiplier across three pillars of our Platform Engineering organization: Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management. Together, these teams own the connectors, orchestration, and data quality capabilities that push ZoomInfo's data product into the systems our customers run every day. 
 This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role. You will embed with whichever team needs the most help at a given time. That might mean a major initiative, a stubborn area of tech debt, a reliability problem, or a chance to grow into new territory. You will lead through influence, not authority. You will set technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and work with Managers, engineers, and Product to turn ambiguity into well-architected, shipped solutions. 
 You will report directly to the Senior Director of Software Engineering and work closely with three Engineering Leaders and their teams. 
  The Three Pillars You'll Support  
 
  Integrations:  Native connectors and APIs that link ZoomInfo to CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, data warehouse, and BI platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Snowflake, and others), processing millions of records daily. 
  Workflows & Orchestration:  The engine behind lead-to-account matching and multi-step, event-driven business processes triggered by buying signals and business rules. 
  Data Management:  Deduplication, standardization, enrichment, continuous verification, and GDPR/CCPA compliance that keep customer data clean, current, and trustworthy. 
 
  What You'll do:  
 
 Embed with Integrations, Workflows & Orchestration, and Data Management teams on a rotating basis, writing production-quality code and unblocking the hardest technical problems 
 Define and evolve scalable, fault-tolerant, event-driven architecture on Java/Spring Boot, Node.js/NestJS, Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal or Google Cloud Workflows 
 Lead response and root-cause analysis for high-severity incidents and systemic reliability issues 
 Drive platform modernization by consolidating integration patterns, re-architecting legacy systems, and improving observability 
 Establish best practices for idempotency, retries, error handling, state management, API and webhook versioning, and workflow design 
 Shape multi-quarter roadmaps with the Senior Director, Engineering Managers, and Product, bringing technical feasibility, sizing, and risk into prioritization 
 Lead build-vs-buy evaluations and author architecture decision records and design docs that guide teams over multiple quarters 
 Mentor engineers at all levels and serve as a senior interviewer to raise the hiring bar 
 
  What you bring:  
  Must-Have  
 
 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in senior or staff-level roles, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams 
 Deep experience designing and operating backend distributed systems at scale, with strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and/or Node.js (NestJS) 
 Experience building or owning integrations or connectors with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, or data warehouse platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Snowflake, or similar) 
 Demonstrated ability to influence without authority by aligning teams, driving decisions, and earning trust across engineering, product, and business stakeholders 
 Strong track record leading platform modernization, reliability, and observability initiatives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to executive leadership 
 
  Preferred  
 
 Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka, and workflow orchestration platforms such as Temporal, Google Cloud Workflows, or Airflow 
 Working knowledge of data quality practices: deduplication, standardization, enrichment, and GDPR/CCPA compliance 
 Experience with API strategy, webhooks, partner/ISV integration programs, and no-code/low-code workflow builders 
 Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP), build-vs-buy evaluations, vendor management, and SaaS cost optimization 
 
   
 #LI-LM1 
 #LI-Remote     Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.
